topic: Postiz: tự host công cụ lên lịch đăng TikTok, YouTube, Discord bằng AI agent

repos.name: Postiz
repos.description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖

notes.audience: Các lập trình viên, nhà sáng trị nội dung và quản trị viên hệ thống có sẵn VPS muốn tự host công cụ quản lý và lên lịch đăng bài mạng xã hội tích hợp AI.
notes.angle: Vì bản tự host miễn phí vĩnh viễn và có MCP cùng CLI để AI agent tự soạn và lên lịch bài đăng, nên đây là cách dân làm nội dung và dev tự host có thể thay Buffer mà không bị khóa tính năng.

facts.fact: Postiz hỗ trợ quản lý, lên lịch và đăng bài lên tới 34 nền tảng mạng xã hội khác nhau từ một lịch chung.
facts.quote: Postiz supports 34 platforms.

facts.fact: Bản tự host của Postiz phát hành theo giấy phép AGPL-3.0, miễn phí vĩnh viễn và người dùng chỉ trả chi phí hạ tầng máy chủ của chính mình.
facts.quote: Free forever (AGPL-3.0); you pay only for your own infra

facts.fact: Postiz cam kết không khóa tính năng (gate features) hay giới hạn giấy phép giữa bản trả phí đám mây và bản tự host mã nguồn mở.
facts.quote: We do not "gate" features or limit the license.

facts.fact: Bản tự host không giới hạn số lượng kênh kết nối, số lượng bài đăng hàng tháng hay số lượng thành viên trong nhóm.
facts.quote: Unlimited, every supported provider

facts.fact: Postiz cung cấp giao diện cho AI agent bao gồm MCP, CLI và các đầu nối tới Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenClaw và Cursor kết nối trực tiếp vào instance tự host.
facts.quote: Agentic surfaces (MCP, CLI, Claude / ChatGPT / Codex / OpenClaw / Cursor connectors)

facts.fact: CLI và MCP cho phép điều khiển trực tiếp Postiz từ terminal hoặc kết nối AI agent ngoài vào hệ thống.
facts.quote: Drive Postiz from your terminal, or connect an AI agent to it.

facts.fact: Tính năng AI Agent trong Postiz hoạt động dưới dạng giao diện chat để người dùng ra lệnh bằng ngôn ngữ tự nhiên thay vì tự điền biểu mẫu soạn thảo.
facts.quote: The agent is a chat that can operate Postiz for you. Rather than opening the composer and filling it in, you describe what you want.

facts.fact: AI Agent có thể lên lịch bài viết cho nhiều kênh, tự sinh ảnh/video và cắt video YouTube dài thành các clip ngắn dọc có gắn phụ đề để làm bản nháp.
facts.quote:
Schedule a post to one channel or several.
Generate images and video for a post.
Turn a long YouTube video into captioned vertical clips and draft them for your channels

facts.fact: Người dùng có thể điều khiển Postiz qua giao thức MCP từ các client như Claude, Cursor hay ChatGPT bằng mô hình AI tùy chọn thay vì dùng chat tích hợp.
facts.quote: If you would rather drive Postiz from a client you already use, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and others, connect through MCP instead. Same capabilities, your choice of model

facts.fact: Các tính năng AI (Copilot, tạo ảnh, tạo video, Smart Agent) trên bản tự host đòi hỏi người dùng tự điền API key (như OpenAI) và không bị giới hạn quota hàng tháng từ Postiz.
facts.quote: Available if you bring your own OpenAI (and other provider) API keys; no quota, you pay the provider

facts.fact: Khi tự host, người dùng phải tự tạo ứng dụng nhà phát triển (developer app) trên từng mạng xã hội và chờ nền tảng xét duyệt.
facts.quote: You create your own developer apps on each platform and go through their approval (Meta, YouTube, TikTok can take weeks)

facts.fact: Bản tự host có thể triển khai trên Docker, Coolify, Railway hoặc VPS bất kỳ, yêu cầu tự cấu hình PostgreSQL, Redis, storage và biến môi trường.
facts.quote: Deploy with Docker / Coolify / Railway / any VPS; you configure Postgres, Redis, storage and env vars

facts.fact: Postiz được xây dựng bằng TypeScript monorepo với pnpm workspaces, NextJS, NestJS, Prisma (PostgreSQL), Temporal và Resend.
facts.quote:
Pnpm workspaces (Monorepo)
- NextJS (React)
- NestJS
- Prisma (Default to PostgreSQL)
- Temporal
- Resend (email notifications)

facts.fact: Khi đăng lên TikTok, Postiz yêu cầu ít nhất một tệp đính kèm gồm một video hoặc nhiều ảnh và không được đăng lẫn lộn cả hai loại media.
facts.quote: At least one attachment. One video or several pictures, never mixed

facts.fact: Khi lên lịch đăng bài YouTube, Postiz bắt buộc chỉ có chính xác một tệp đính kèm duy nhất và phải là định dạng video.
facts.quote: Exactly one attachment, and it must be a video

facts.fact: Trình soạn thảo cho Discord hỗ trợ định dạng Markdown và kết nối thông qua luồng OAuth với giới hạn 1.980 ký tự.
facts.quote: Discord	discord	OAuth	Yes	1,980

facts.fact: Postiz cung cấp tính năng tạo đường link mời để khách hàng tự ủy quyền tài khoản mạng xã hội vào tổ chức mà không cần chia sẻ mật khẩu.
facts.quote: The button next to Add Channel generates an invite link you can send them. They open it, authorise their own account, and the channel lands in your organisation.

facts.fact: Trong tổng số 34 nền tảng hỗ trợ, hiện chỉ có 10 nền tảng gửi dữ liệu phân tích chỉ số cấp tài khoản (account-level analytics) về lại cho Postiz.
facts.quote: Only 10 platforms report account-level analytics back to Postiz.

facts.fact: Postiz không thu thập nội dung bằng hình thức cào web (scraping) và không proxy hay thu thập access token / API key trái phép.
facts.quote: Postiz does not automate or scrape content from social media platforms.

facts.fact: Người dùng Postiz luôn xác thực trực tiếp với nền tảng mạng xã hội qua OAuth chính thức để đảm bảo tính tuân thủ và quyền riêng tư dữ liệu.
facts.quote: Postiz users always authenticate directly with the social platform (e.g., X, Discord, etc.), ensuring platform compliance and data privacy.

caveats: Tự host đòi hỏi người dùng phải tự đăng ký ứng dụng nhà phát triển (developer app) trên từng mạng xã hội (Meta, YouTube, TikTok) và thời gian chờ xét duyệt có thể mất nhiều tuần.
Bản tự host không cấp sẵn hạn mức AI; người dùng phải tự cung cấp API key riêng (như OpenAI) và tự trả phí cho nhà cung cấp AI.
Người tự host phải tự chịu trách nhiệm vận hành hạ tầng, cấu hình Redis/PostgreSQL/Storage, tự sao lưu và tự chạy lệnh migration khi cập nhật phiên bản.
AI Agent của Postiz bị giới hạn: không thể đọc hoặc trả lời bình luận trên bài đăng, không thể tự kết nối kênh mới và không thể thay đổi cài đặt hệ thống hay thanh toán.
Chỉ có 10 trong số 34 nền tảng hỗ trợ báo cáo dữ liệu phân tích (analytics) ngược về giao diện Postiz, và yêu cầu app developer phải có quyền analytics scopes.
Các nền tảng như YouTube và TikTok không hỗ trợ tính năng đăng thêm phần bình luận phụ hoặc luồng tiếp nối (threads/comments) trực tiếp từ bộ soạn thảo.
gaps: Các tài liệu trong nguồn không cung cấp file mẫu docker-compose.yml hoặc các dòng lệnh cụ thể để chạy Postiz trên VPS.
Nguồn chưa nêu rõ cấu hình phần cứng VPS tối thiểu (CPU, RAM, dung lượng ổ đĩa) để vận hành đồng thời toàn bộ stack gồm Temporal, Redis, PostgreSQL, NestJS và NextJS.
Chưa có hướng dẫn cấu hình chi tiết cho MCP server (cổng, token bảo mật, file config JSON) để kết nối từ Claude Desktop hoặc Cursor tới máy chủ Postiz tự host.
Cách thiết lập dịch vụ lưu trữ media tải lên (local volume hay S3/R2) trong biến môi trường chưa được liệt kê cụ thể trong tài liệu cung cấp.

## Quick Start

## Sponsor Postiz

- Main repository: Get your logo with a backlink from the main Postiz repository. Postiz has over 7M downloads and 20k views per month.

Link: https://opencollective.com/postiz

 
  

## Postiz Cloud vs. Open-source

Choose [Postiz Cloud](https://postiz.com/) for a fully managed experience, or deploy Postiz Open-source on your own infrastructure. Both provide the same core Postiz product and features.

We do not "gate" features or limit the license.

The main difference is the infrastructure you need to own, approval from social media providers, and deployment that might be hard at times (let your LLM deploy it)

| Area | Postiz Cloud | Postiz Open-source (self-hosted) |
|---|---|---|
| **Cost** | Subscription per plan, 7-day free trial | Free forever (AGPL-3.0); you pay only for your own infra |
| **Setup time** | Sign up and connect channels in minutes | Deploy with Docker / Coolify / Railway / any VPS; you configure Postgres, Redis, storage and env vars |
| **Hosting & data** | Hosted by Postiz; data stored in our infrastructure | Runs on your own server; data never leaves your environment |
| **Social platform apps** | Pre-approved apps for every channel, ready to use | You create your own developer apps on each platform and go through their approval (Meta, YouTube, TikTok can take weeks) |
| **Channels** | Limited by plan tier | Unlimited, every supported provider |
| **Posts per month** | Limited by plan tier | Unlimited |
| **Team members** | Limited by plan tier | Unlimited |
| **Scheduling, calendar views, cross-posting, repeated posts, post comments & delays, sets, signatures** | Included | Included |
| **Internal & Global Plugs, RSS auto-post, customer groups** | Included per plan | Included |
| **Analytics** | Included per plan | Included (requires your own app credentials with analytics scopes) |
| **AI Copilot, AI images, AI videos** | Included with monthly quotas per plan; keys managed by Postiz | Available if you bring your own OpenAI (and other provider) API keys; no quota, you pay the provider |
| **AI video clipping** | Included with monthly clipping minutes per plan | Requires your own provider keys and extra configuration |
| **Smart Agent** | Included per plan | Available with your own LLM key |
| **Public API & webhooks** | Included per plan | Included |
| **Agentic surfaces (MCP, CLI, Claude / ChatGPT / Codex / OpenClaw / Cursor connectors)** | Included, hosted MCP endpoint | Included, you point the MCP / CLI at your own instance |
| **Custom integrations** | Included per plan | Included; you can also modify the code and add providers |
| **Updates & maintenance** | Automatic, zero downtime for you | You pull new images and run migrations yourself |
| **Uptime, backups, security patches** | Managed by Postiz | Your responsibility |
| **Support** | Priority support via Discord / email per plan | Community support on Discord and GitHub |
| **Source access & customization** | No (SaaS) | Full source code, fork and modify freely under AGPL |
| **Compliance / data residency** | Postiz-controlled regions | Any region or air-gapped environment you choose |

  
## Postiz Compliance

- This GitHub repository contains the open-source, self-hosted edition of Postiz. Postiz is also available as Postiz Cloud, a fully managed service at postiz.com.
- Postiz hosted service uses official, platform-approved OAuth flows.
- Postiz does not automate or scrape content from social media platforms.
- Postiz does not collect, store, or proxy API keys or access tokens from users.
- Postiz never asks users to paste API keys into our hosted product.
- Postiz users always authenticate directly with the social platform (e.g., X, Discord, etc.), ensuring platform compliance and data privacy.

## License

This repository's source code is available under the [AGPL-3.0 license](LICENSE).

## brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio (https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio)
Description: Open-source, self-hostable social media management platform. Schedule, publish, and manage content across 10+ platforms from a single dashboard. Free alternative to Buffer, Sendible, and SocialPilot.
Homepage: https://brightbean.xyz/studio/
Language: Python; license: AGPL-3.0; created 2026-03-25; last push 2026-10-25
No releases
README (start):
Open-source social media management for creators, agencies, and SMBs.

  
  
  
  

  

---

## About BrightBean Studio

BrightBean Studio is an open-source, self-hostable social media management platform built for creators, agencies and SMBs. It does what Sendible, SocialPilot, or ContentStudio do, but free and without per-seat, per-channel, or per-workspace limits. Plan, compose, schedule, approve, publish, and monitor content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Mastodon, and DEV.to from a single multi-workspace dashboard.

It's for people managing many client accounts under one roof who'd rather own their social stack than pay $100–300/month to a SaaS vendor. Every feature is available to every user. No paid tier, no feature gate, no upsell.

A free hosted version is available at [brightbean.xyz/studio](https://brightbean.xyz/studio/). You can also deploy it yourself with a one-click button on Heroku, Render, or Railway, run it on your own VPS via Docker, or run it locally. All platform integrations talk directly to the official first-party APIs using your own developer credentials, so there's no aggregator middleman, no vendor lock-in, and no third party sitting between you and your data.

## Features

| | |
|---|---|
| **Multi-workspace & teams** | Unlimited orgs → workspaces → members. Granular RBAC with custom roles, invitations, and a separate Client role for external collaborators. |
| **Content composer** | Rich editor with per-platform caption/media overrides, version history, reusable templates, content categories & tags, a Kanban idea board. |
| **Calendar & scheduling** | Visual calendar with recurring weekly posting slots per account and named queues that auto-assign posts to the next available slot. |
| **Publishing engine** | Direct first-party API integrations (no aggregator), automatic retries, per-account rate-limit tracking, and a 90-day publish audit log. |
| **Approval workflows** | Configurable stages (none / optional / internal / internal + client), threaded internal & external comments, reminders, and a full audit trail. |
| **Unified social inbox** | Comments, mentions, DMs, and reviews from every connected platform in one place, with sentiment analysis, assignments, threaded replies, and historical backfill. |
| **Analytics** | Per-post and channel-level performance from every connected platform's native API, with KPI cards, 7/30/90-day trend charts, and a sortable all-posts table for views, engagement, follower growth, reach, and watch time. |
| **Media library** | Org- and workspace-scoped libraries with nested folders, auto-generated platform-optimized variants, alt text, and built-in Unsplash stock-photo search in the composer. |
| **Client portal** | Passwordless 30-day magic-link access so clients can approve or reject posts without creating an account. |
| **Notifications** | In-app, email, and webhook delivery with per-user preferences for every event type. |
| **Security & ops** | Encrypted token & credential storage, Google SSO, Sentry support, and a 14-day org-deletion grace period for non-YouTube data. YouTube connections and copied API data are removed immediately when deletion is requested. 2FA (TOTP) is on the roadmap. |
| **White-label friendly** | Per-workspace branding (logo, colors) and workspace defaults for hashtags, first comments, and posting templates. |

### A quick look

  
    Visual calendar - drag-and-drop scheduling with recurring slots and queues.
  
  
    Post editor - composer with per-platform overrides and previews.
    Idea board - Kanban workflow to keep track of all your post ideas.
  
  
    Connect anything - 10+ first-party integrations, no aggregator.
    Performance analytics - per-post and channel-level metrics with KPI cards and trend charts.
  

## Supported Platforms

|  Instagram | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

### Hosted Version

A free hosted version of Brightbean Studio is available at [brightbean.xyz/studio](https://brightbean.xyz/studio/). It runs the same codebase as this repository, with no setup or maintenance required.

If you'd rather self-host, choose one of the options below.

### One-Click Deploy

| Heroku | Render | Railway |
|:------:|:------:|:-------:|
| [](https://heroku.com/deploy?template=https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio) | [](https://render.com/deploy?repo=https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio) | [](https://railway.com/deploy/brightbean-studio?referralCode=brightbean) |

After deploying, set these environment variables in your platform's dashboard:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE` | Auto-set | `config.settings.production`. Set if deployment config has not placed it. |
| `SECRET_KEY` | Auto-generated | Django secret key. Set automatically by the deploy button. |
| `ENCRYPTION_KEY_SALT` | Auto-generated | Encryption salt. Set automatically by the deploy button. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | Auto-provisioned | PostgreSQL connection string. Set automatically. |
| `ALLOWED_HOSTS` | Yes | Your app's domain, e.g. `your-app.herokuapp.com` |
| `APP_URL` | Yes | Full public URL, e.g. `https://your-app.herokuapp.com` |
| `STORAGE_BACKEND` | No | Set to `s3` for S3/R2 storage. Default: `local`. Heroku, Render, and Railway have ephemeral filesystems, so uploaded files are lost on redeploy without S3. |
| `SERVE_MEDIA` | No | Only used with `STORAGE_BACKEND=local`. Default: `true`, so Django serves uploads at `/media/`. Those files are served **unauthenticated** — anyone with the path can fetch them. That is required in this mode: Instagram, Threads, Facebook, Pinterest, Google Business and dev.to fetch attachment URLs server-side when publishing, so `/media/` must be publicly reachable. Only the media library, avatars and workspace icons are exposed this way (`PUBLIC_MEDIA_PREFIXES` in `config/urls.py`); comment attachments go through a permission-checked view. Set to `false` only when a reverse proxy or CDN serves those prefixes on the same public path instead. |
| `CADDY_MEDIA_ROOT` | No | docker-compose only. Where Caddy reads uploads from. Default: `/app/media`. Set to `/var/empty` when `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` — the `media_data` volume survives the switch and Caddy cannot see `SERVE_MEDIA`, so it would otherwise keep serving whatever uploads were left behind. |
| `S3_ENDPOINT_URL` | If using S3 | S3-compatible endpoint URL |
| `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | If using S3 | S3 access key |
| `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | If using S3 | S3 secret key |
| `S3_BUCKET_NAME` | If using S3 | S3 bucket name |
| `EMAIL_HOST` | No | SMTP server for sending invitations and password resets |
| `EMAIL_PORT` | No | SMTP port (default: `587`) |
| `EMAIL_HOST_USER` | No | SMTP username |
| `EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD` | No | SMTP password |
| `GOOGLE_AUTH_CLIENT_ID` | No | For Google OAuth login. Get from [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/) → Credentials. |
| `GOOGLE_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` | No | Google OAuth secret |
| `CUSTOM_SIGNUP_URL` | No | Where "Sign up" links point, e.g. a waitlist or marketing page: the login page's link, the email sent when someone resets the password of an address with no account, and the redirect after an owner deletes their organization. Must be an `http(s)://` URL or a path starting with `/`. Default: the built-in `/accounts/signup/`. With `SIGNUP_MODE=open` that page stays open either way (so your page can link back to it); with `invite` or `closed`, everyone who may not sign up is redirected here instead (see [Restricting Sign-up](#restricting-sign-up)). People with a pending invite are sent to the built-in signup, since only it accepts the invite (except with `closed`, where invites cannot create accounts). |
| `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY` | No | Enables Unsplash stock-photo search in the composer. Create a free app at [unsplash.com/developers](https://unsplash.com/developers). |

For social media API keys, see [Platform Credentials](#platform-credentials). Full variable reference: `.env.example`.

## Quick Start (Docker)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio.git
cd brightbean-studio
cp .env.example .env
```

Edit `.env` - change `DATABASE_URL` to point to the Docker service name:

```
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@postgres:5432/brightbean
```

Then start everything:

```bash
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec app python manage.py createsuperuser
```

Database migrations run automatically via the `migrate` Compose service before
the `app` and `worker` services start, so there is no separate migrate step.

Tailwind compiles automatically via the `tailwind` Compose service. First build
takes ~60–90 seconds (running `npm install` in a fresh container); subsequent
starts are instant. Watch progress with `docker compose logs -f tailwind`.

Open http://localhost:8000 - you're running.

## Fully Local Development (without Docker)

Run everything natively - no Docker, no PostgreSQL install. Uses SQLite for the database.

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.12+
- Node.js 20+

### Setup

**1. Clone and configure**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-studio.git
cd brightbean-studio
cp .env.example .env
```

**2. Switch to SQLite**

Open `.env` and replace the `DATABASE_URL` line:

```
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///db.sqlite3
```

That's it - no database server to install or manage.

**3. Set up Python**

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

**4. Set up Tailwind CSS**

```bash
cd theme/static_src
npm install
cd ../..
```

**5. Run database migrations**

```bash
python manage.py migrate
```

**6. Create your admin account**

```bash
python manage.py createsuperuser
```

**7. Start the app (3 terminal tabs)**

Tab 1 - Tailwind watcher:
```bash
cd theme/static_src && npm run start
```

Tab 2 - Django dev server:
```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
python manage.py runserver
```

Tab 3 - Background worker:
```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
python manage.py run_studio_worker
```

Open http://localhost:8000 and log in with the superuser you created.

### Daily workflow (Docker-free)

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate                # activate Python env
python manage.py runserver               # start web server
# (open another tab)
python manage.py run_studio_worker           # start worker
```

> **Note:** SQLite is fine for local development and small deployments. For production or heavy concurrent usage, switch to PostgreSQL.

# SocialManager — Personal Social Media Manager

A self-hosted, local-first social media management platform. Aggregate feeds from all your platforms, compose and cross-post content, schedule posts, and get AI-powered suggestions — all from one dashboard.

---

## Features

- **Unified Feed** — Pull feeds from Twitter/X, Mastodon, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit and YouTube into a single dashboard
- **Filter & Tag** — Filter your feed by platform or custom tags
- **Cross-post** — Write once, publish to multiple platforms simultaneously
- **Scheduler** — Schedule posts for a specific date/time with BullMQ job queue
- **AI Assistance** — Grammar correction and platform-specific content adaptation (T5 model, runs locally)
- **Multi-language UI** — English and Turkish built-in; adding a new language is a single file
- **Microservices** — Each platform is an independent service, easy to add or remove
- **Fully local** — No SaaS, no subscriptions. Runs entirely on your machine via Docker

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Frontend | Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Pinia, Vue Router, vue-i18n |
| API Gateway | Node.js / Fastify |
| Message Broker | RabbitMQ |
| Database | MongoDB |
| Job Queue | Redis + BullMQ |
| AI Service | Python / HappyTransformer (T5) |
| Platform SDKs | twitter-api-v2, masto, @atproto/api |
| Reverse Proxy | Nginx |
| Containerization | Docker Compose |

---

## Services

| Service | Port | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| `nginx` | 8081 | Reverse proxy — main entry point |
| `ui` | — | Vue 3 frontend (Vite dev server) |
| `gateway` | 8084 | REST API gateway |
| `socket` | 8085 | WebSocket server (real-time feed updates) |
| `formatter` | — | Platform-specific content formatter |
| `ai-grammar-correction` | — | AI grammar correction (T5) |
| `feed-aggregator` | 3010 | Pulls feeds from all platforms periodically |
| `scheduler` | 3011 | Scheduled post management (BullMQ) |
| `twitter` | 3001 | Twitter/X integration |
| `linkedin` | 3002 | LinkedIn integration |
| `mastodon` | 3003 | Mastodon integration |
| `bluesky` | 3004 | Bluesky (AT Protocol) integration |
| `mongodb` | 27018 | Database |
| `redis` | 6379 | Cache & job queue |
| `messageBroker` | 5672 / 15672 | RabbitMQ (+ management UI) |

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mehmetkirkoca/social-media-manager.git
cd social-media-manager
```

### 2. Configure environment

```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

Edit `.env` and fill in your API credentials for the platforms you want to use. You can start with just Mastodon or Bluesky — both have free, open APIs.

```env
# Mastodon (easiest — get token from instance Settings > Development)
MASTODON_INSTANCE_URL=https://mastodon.social
MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN=your_token_here

# Bluesky (use an App Password from Settings > App Passwords)
BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER=yourhandle.bsky.social
BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD=your_app_password_here
```

### 3. Start the application

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

Open **http://localhost:8081** in your browser.

---

## Platform Connection Guide

| Platform | API Cost | Feed | Post | Notes |
|----------|----------|------|------|-------|
| Mastodon | Free | ✅ | ✅ | Easiest — open REST API |
| Bluesky | Free | ✅ | ✅ | App Password auth, no OAuth needed |
| Reddit | Free | ✅ | ✅ | Register an app at reddit.com/prefs/apps |
| Twitter/X | Paid ($100/mo Basic) | ⚠️ | ✅ | Free tier very limited |
| LinkedIn | Free | ⚠️ | ✅ | Personal feed read not available via API |
| Instagram | Free | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | Business/Creator account required |
| YouTube | Free | ✅ | ❌ | Subscription feed read-only |

## Adding a New Language

1. Create `ui/src/locales/xx.ts` (copy `en.ts` and translate)
2. In `ui/src/locales/index.ts`:
   ```ts
   import xx from './xx'
   // Add to messages: { en, tr, xx }
   // Add to SUPPORTED_LOCALES: { code: 'xx', label: '...', flag: '🇽🇽' }
   ```
3. Done — language will appear in the NavBar dropdown automatically

---

## Adding a New Platform

1. Create `services/{platform}/` with `index.js`, `package.json`, `Dockerfile`
2. Extend `BasePlatformService` and implement `fetchFeed()`, `publishPost()`, `getStatus()`
3. Add the service to `docker-compose.yml`
4. Add the service URL to `feed-aggregator` and `scheduler` environment variables
5. Add platform metadata to `ui/src/stores/platforms.ts`

From an empty account to a scheduled post, in five steps

Copy page
This walks through the whole loop once: get into Postiz, connect a channel, write a post, schedule it, and confirm it went out. It is the same in both Postiz Cloud and a self-hosted install.
Looking for installation instructions? Those moved to Installation options.
​
Step 1: Get into Postiz
Postiz Cloud
Self-hosted
Sign up at postiz.com and pick a plan. There is no free tier on cloud: the app stays behind the plan picker until you subscribe, and new organisations are usually offered a 7 day trial.
Once you are in, you land on the Calendar.
​
Step 2: Connect a channel
A channel is one connected social account: one X profile, one Discord server, one LinkedIn page. Everything else in Postiz hangs off channels.
1

Open the channel list

On the Calendar, the left sidebar lists your channels. Click Add Channel.
2

Pick a platform

You will get one of four connection flows depending on the platform: a normal OAuth redirect, a credentials form you fill in yourself, an instance URL prompt, or the browser extension. See Connect a channel for what each one means.
Postiz Cloud
Self-hosted
Every platform is ready to connect. Click it, authorise on the platform’s own screen, and you come back to Postiz.
3

Confirm it appears

The channel shows up in the sidebar with its avatar. A red marker means it needs attention, usually a reconnect.
​
Step 3: Write the post
Click Create Post, or click any empty slot on the calendar to start at that time.
Select the channels you want to publish to at the top of the composer.
Write once in the Global tab. The same text goes to every selected channel. To tailor one of them, switch to that channel’s tab and unlock it, see Global vs per-channel content.
Add media by dragging a file into the editor, pasting an image, or picking from the media library.
Fill in the per-channel settings on the right. Some platforms require them: YouTube needs a title, Reddit needs a subreddit, Pinterest needs a board.
The preview column on the right renders the post as each platform will show it, which is the fastest way to catch a bad line break or a truncated title.
​
Step 4: Schedule it
Pick a date and time at the bottom of the composer, then choose how to publish:
Button	What it does
Save as Draft	Keeps it on the calendar, never publishes it
Add to calendar	Schedules it for the time you picked
Post Now	Publishes immediately, hover the schedule button to find it
If a channel is missing something required, Postiz blocks the save and jumps you to the offending channel with the error shown. See Validation errors.
​
Step 5: Confirm it published
Back on the calendar, the post appears in its slot. After the scheduled time it switches to published, and the Preview action on the post card opens the live version.
If it failed, the card gets a red ring and the error is in the tooltip. The usual causes are a channel that needs reconnecting or a platform rule the post broke, see Posting rules by platform.
​

Copy page
Where: the Agent section
Availability: Postiz Cloud, Standard plan and above. Self-hosted installs need AI keys configured on the instance.
The agent is a chat that can operate Postiz for you. Rather than opening the composer and filling it in, you describe what you want.
​
The layout
Left: which channels the agent may act on.
Centre: the conversation.
Right: your previous conversations, plus Start a new chat.
​
What it can do
Schedule a post to one channel or several.
Generate images and video for a post.
Turn a long YouTube video into captioned vertical clips and draft them for your channels, see Video clipping.
Open the composer prefilled, so you can review and adjust before saving.
You can attach media to the conversation, so “post this image on Thursday morning with a caption about X” works as one message.
​
Working with it
Select the channels first. The agent acts on what is selected, so a narrow selection is a useful guardrail while you are learning what it does.
Ask it to draft rather than publish while you are getting a feel for it. A draft lands on the calendar where you can inspect it, and nothing reaches an audience until you promote it.
Conversations are kept, so you can return to one and continue rather than re-explaining context.
​
What it cannot do
Read or reply to comments on your posts.
Connect a channel for you.
Change billing or settings.
​
The agent versus MCP
The agent is Postiz’s own chat, using Postiz’s model. If you would rather drive Postiz from a client you already use, Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and others, connect through MCP instead. Same capabilities, your choice of model, and it works alongside whatever else that client can do.

Copy page
Postiz supports 34 platforms. They disagree about almost everything: how many images a post can carry, whether a thread is a thread or a comment, whether text alone is allowed. This page is the reference for all of it.
​
Every platform
How you connect it is what happens when you click the platform in Add Channel:
OAuth: you are redirected to the platform and authorise there.
Credentials in Postiz: you paste your own API key or app password into a dialog. Nothing to register anywhere.
In-app dialog: a platform-specific connect step inside Postiz.
Browser extension: the Postiz extension reads your existing session.
Needs a developer app only matters if you self-host: it means the platform requires API keys that the person running the instance has to register and configure. On Postiz Cloud this is already done for every platform.
Platform	API __type	How you connect it	Self-hosted: needs a developer app	Characters
X	x	OAuth	Yes	varies
LinkedIn	linkedin	OAuth	Yes	3,000
LinkedIn Page	linkedin-page	OAuth	Yes	3,000
Reddit	reddit	OAuth	Yes	10,000
Instagram (Facebook Business)	instagram	OAuth	Yes	2,200
Instagram (Standalone)	instagram-standalone	OAuth	Yes	2,200
Facebook Page	facebook	OAuth	Yes	63,206
Threads	threads	OAuth	Yes	500
YouTube	youtube	OAuth	Yes	5,000
Google My Business	gmb	OAuth	Yes	1,500
TikTok	tiktok	OAuth	Yes	2,000
TikTok Business	tiktok-business	OAuth	Yes	2,000
Pinterest	pinterest	OAuth	Yes	500
Dribbble	dribbble	OAuth	Yes	40,000
Discord	discord	OAuth	Yes	1,980
Slack	slack	OAuth	Yes	400,000
Kick	kick	OAuth	Yes	500
Twitch	twitch	OAuth	Yes	500
Mastodon	mastodon	OAuth	Yes	500
Bluesky	bluesky	Credentials in Postiz	No	300
Lemmy	lemmy	Credentials in Postiz	No	10,000
Farcaster	wrapcast	In-app dialog	Yes	800
Telegram	telegram	In-app dialog	Yes	4,096
Nostr	nostr	Credentials in Postiz	No	100,000
VK	vk	OAuth	Yes	2,048
Medium	medium	Credentials in Postiz	No	100,000

X is the exception in that table. Its limit depends on the post: 280 characters normally, 4,000 if the account is verified, and 100,000 in long-form article mode.
​
Names that differ between the app and the API
Four platforms are called one thing in the interface and another in the API. If you are working with the Public API, the CLI or MCP, use the right-hand column.
In the app	In the API __type
Farcaster	wrapcast
X	x
Google My Business	gmb
Dev.to	devto
​
Media rules
The composer blocks a post that breaks these before it ever reaches the platform.
Platform	Media rules
X	Up to 4 images or 1 video. Text-only is fine. In article mode, images only, and a draft article cannot have thread replies
LinkedIn, LinkedIn Page	One attachment if it is a video. A carousel needs at least 2 images and no video. Comments can only contain text
Bluesky	Up to 4 images or 1 video. Text-only is fine
Instagram, Instagram Standalone	At least one attachment is required. A story takes a single picture. A trial reel is exactly one video
Facebook Page	Text-only, photos, or a video. A story needs at least one attachment, and each attachment publishes as its own story
YouTube	Exactly one attachment, and it must be a video
TikTok	At least one attachment. One video or several pictures, never mixed
Pinterest	At least one media, maximum 5 images. A video pin needs two attachments: the video and a cover image
Dribbble	Exactly one attachment, images only
Google My Business	Text-only or exactly one image. No video
Farcaster	Images only
Reddit	A media-type subreddit post needs exactly one attachment. Video posts need a thumbnail
Tumblr	Up to 30 images, up to 1 video
Everything else	No specific restriction enforced by Postiz
​
Threads and comments
Postiz lets you add extra parts to a post. What those parts become depends on the platform: a genuine thread, a comment on your own post, or nothing.
Support	Platforms
Threads and comments	Most platforms
Comments cannot carry media	Instagram, Kick, Twitch
No extra parts at all	YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, MeWe, Tumblr
Comments are text-only	LinkedIn, LinkedIn Page
See Threads and comments for how to add them and set delays between parts.
​
Editors
The composer changes what it offers per platform, because platforms accept different content.
Editor	What you get	Platforms
Plain	No formatting	Platforms that render text as-is
Standard	Bold, underline, emoji	Most social platforms
Markdown	Adds links, lists and headings	Discord, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, Whop
HTML	Rich formatting	X, WordPress, Listmonk
​
Platform details
Most platforms behave the way you would expect. These are the ones with rules that catch people out.

X: long-form articles and reply controls

TikTok: direct post vs upload

Instagram: reels, stories and trial reels

LinkedIn: carousels are PDFs

Pinterest: video pins need a cover

Reddit: settings are per subreddit

YouTube: exactly one video

Facebook: stories and background posts

Google Business: no video, and post types

Blogging platforms: Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, WordPress

Discord, Slack, Telegram: bots and channels

Mastodon, Bluesky, Nostr, Lemmy: self-hosted and federated

Analytics support
Only 10 platforms report account-level analytics back to Postiz. See Analytics for the metric list and date ranges.

Platforms with no connect button
Some platforms are fully supported for scheduling and publishing through the Public API but have no in-app connect flow yet: Twitch, Kick, VK, Nostr, Lemmy, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, WordPress, Listmonk and Moltbook.

The four ways a platform connects, and what to do when one fails

Copy page
Where: Calendar, left sidebar, Add Channel
A channel is one connected social account. Everything else in Postiz, the calendar, the composer, analytics, hangs off channels, so this is the first thing you do.
​
The four connection flows
Which one you get depends on the platform, not on a setting. The Add Channel dialog picks automatically.
OAuth redirect
Credentials you supply
In-app dialog
Browser extension
The common case: X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Discord, Slack and most others.
You click the platform, get sent to the platform’s own authorisation screen, approve, and land back in Postiz with the channel connected.
Some platforms then ask a follow-up question, because one account can contain several destinations. Facebook asks which Page, YouTube which channel, Tumblr which blog, LinkedIn Page which company. Postiz calls this a “continue integration” step and the channel is not usable until you finish it.
​
Letting a client connect their own account
You do not have to hold a client’s password. The button next to Add Channel generates an invite link you can send them. They open it, authorise their own account, and the channel lands in your organisation.
Invite links only cover platforms that redirect cleanly, so platforms needing an instance URL, custom credentials or the browser extension are excluded from that list. See Client groups and invite links.
​
After connecting
The channel appears in the left sidebar with its avatar. Two markers are worth knowing:
A red exclamation means the channel needs attention. Usually the token expired and it needs reconnecting, sometimes an unfinished setup step.
Faded out at half opacity means the channel is disabled.
​
When a connect fails

The platform is missing or greyed out

"Invalid state" after authorising

The channel connected but posts fail immediately
